title: Trading
summary: Swap items and shards with another awakened: how to ask, what can never be traded, and when a trade is called off.

blocks.text: Walk up to an awakened and press T (Trade). He has 30 s to accept; two awakened asking each other at the same time open the trade at once. Both must be level 3 or more. Wait 4 s between two requests. Each side offers up to 8 things (items of the bag, tradeable cosmetics) and up to 10,000,000 shards . Any change puts both sides back to not ready . When both are ready, a 3 s countdown runs, everything is checked again, then the swap is made and both profiles are saved at the same moment.
blocks.html:
• Walk up to an awakened and press T (Trade). He has 30 s to accept; two awakened asking each other at the same time open the trade at once.
  • Both must be level 3 or more. Wait 4 s between two requests.
  • Each side offers up to 8 things (items of the bag, tradeable cosmetics) and up to 10,000,000 shards.
  • Any change puts both sides back to not ready. When both are ready, a 3 s countdown runs, everything is checked again, then the swap is made and both profiles are saved at the same moment.

blocks.text: Worn items, locked items and the special editions ( EX and SP ): see each item's Tradeable line. The rank cosmetics. A gemstone cosmetic can be traded if the other awakened does not own it already (a worn one comes off).
blocks.html:
• Worn items, locked items and the special editions (EX and SP): see each item's Tradeable line.
  • The rank cosmetics. A gemstone cosmetic can be traded if the other awakened does not own it already (a worn one comes off).

blocks.text: The trade stops if one of you leaves, falls, goes more than 60 studs away, walks into a rift, the menu or the colosseum, or closes the window.
blocks.html: The trade stops if one of you leaves, falls, goes more than 60 studs away, walks into a rift, the menu or the colosseum, or closes the window.

blocks.text: Only awakened of close regional price levels can trade together (gear and shards bought cheaper elsewhere stay there). Trading is off where Roblox does not allow trading paid items. Don't want requests? Turn Trades off in Options : you get none and nobody sees your Trade prompt.
blocks.html:
• Only awakened of close regional price levels can trade together (gear and shards bought cheaper elsewhere stay there).
  • Trading is off where Roblox does not allow trading paid items.
  • Don't want requests? Turn Trades off in Options: you get none and nobody sees your Trade prompt.
